collection.title: Ford Mondeo Hatchback 2000 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Mondeo Hatchback 2000 to 2006 version uses a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Mondeo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
